placementResultsDetail.message: Always the same spot, at the top of the results column. When an AI Overview fills the first row, the card sits below it.

placementWide.message: Top right when there is room
placementWide.description: Placement option: use the empty band beside a full-width block

placementWideDetail.message: Moves up beside an AI Overview, into the empty band on its right. Only when the first row is filled edge to edge and the window is wide enough (about 1750px) — otherwise it falls back to the position above, so the card is not always in the same place. That band is outside Google's own columns, so it sits further from the results.
placementWideDetail.description: Explanation and trade-offs of the wide placement
